title: Unveiling the bioinformatic genes and their involved regulatory mechanisms in type 2 diabetes combined with osteoarthritis.
authors: Mao, Guangming; Xu, Wenhao; Wan, Lingli; Wang, Hongpin; Xu, Shutao; Zhang, Liangming; Li, Shiyang; Zhang, Jifa; Lai, Zhongming; Lan, Yuping; Liu, Jianhui
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析T2D与OA共享基因及调控网络，虽涉及转录因子预测和分子对接，但核心是疾病标志物与诊断，非蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2D) and Osteoarthritis (OA) are both prevalent diseases that significantly impact the health of patients. Increasing evidence suggests that there is a big correlation between T2D and OA, but the molecular mechanisms remain elusive. The aims of this study are to investigate the shared biomarkers and potential molecular mechanisms in T2D combined with OA. METHODS: T2D and OA-related differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified via bioinformatic analysis on Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) datasets GSE26168 and GSE114007 respectively. Subsequently, extensive target prediction and network analysis were finished with Gene Ontology (GO), protein-protein interaction (PPI), and pathway enrichment with DEGs. The transcription factors (TFs) and miRNAs coupled in co-expressed DEGs involved in T2D and OA were predicted as well. The key genes expressed both in the clinical tissues of T2D and OA were detected with western blot and qRT-PCR assay. Finally, the most promising candidate compounds were predicted with the Drug-Gene Interaction Database (DGIdb) and molecular docking. RESULTS: In this study, 209 shared DEGs between T2D and OA were identified. Functional analysis disclosed that these DEGs are predominantly related to ossification, regulation of leukocyte migration, extracellular matrix (ECM) structural constituents, PI3K/AKT, and Wnt signaling pathways. Further analysis via Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) analysis and validation with external datasets emphasized MMP9 and ANGPTL4 as crucial genes in both T2D and OA. Our findings were validated through qRT-PCR and Western blot analyses, which indicated high expression levels of these pivotal genes in T2D, OA, and T2D combined with OA cases. Additionally, the analysis of Transcription Factors (TFs)-miRNA interactions identified 7 TFs and one miRNA that jointly regulate these important genes. The Receiver Operating characteristic (ROC) analysis demonstrated the significant diagnostic potential of MMP9 and ANGPTL4.Moreover, we identified raloxifene, ezetimibe, and S-3304 as promising agents for patients with both T2D and OA. CONCLUSION: This study uncovers the shared signaling pathways, biomarkers, potential therapeutics, and diagnostic models for individuals suffering from both T2D and OA. These findings not only present novel perspectives on the complex interplay between T2D and OA but also hold significant promise for improving the clinical management and prognosis of patients with this concurrent condition.
abstract_zh: 背景：2型糖尿病（T2D）和骨关节炎（OA）均为常见疾病，显著影响患者健康。越来越多的证据表明，T2D与OA之间存在密切关联，但其分子机制仍不明确。本研究旨在探讨T2D合并OA的共享生物标志物及潜在分子机制。方法：通过对基因表达综合数据库（GEO）数据集GSE26168和GSE114007进行生物信息学分析，分别鉴定T2D和OA相关的差异表达基因（DEGs）。随后，利用基因本体论（GO）、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）及通路富集分析，对DEGs进行广泛靶点预测和网络分析。同时，预测了T2D和OA中共表达DEGs中偶联的转录因子（TFs）和miRNA。通过western blot和qRT-PCR实验检测T2D和OA临床组织中关键基因的表达。最后，利用药物-基因相互作用数据库（DGIdb）和分子对接预测最有前景的候选化合物。结果：本研究共鉴定出209个T2D和OA共享的DEGs。功能分析显示，这些DEGs主要与骨化、白细胞迁移调控、细胞外基质（ECM）结构成分、PI3K/AKT及Wnt信号通路相关。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）分析及外部数据集验证，进一步强调MMP9和ANGPTL4为T2D和OA中的关键基因。我们的发现通过qRT-PCR和Western blot分析得到验证，表明这些关键基因在T2D、OA及T2D合并OA病例中高表达。此外，转录因子（TFs）-miRNA相互作用分析识别出7个TFs和一个miRNA共同调控这些重要基因。受试者工作特征（ROC）分析显示MMP9和ANGPTL4具有显著的诊断潜力。此外，我们确定雷洛昔芬、依折麦布和S-3304为T2D合并OA患者的有前景治疗药物。结论：本研究揭示了T2D和OA共病患者共享的信号通路、生物标志物、潜在治疗药物及诊断模型。这些发现不仅为T2D与OA之间的复杂相互作用提供了新视角，而且对改善这一并发疾病患者的临床管理和预后具有重要前景。
